title: Causal Analysis of ASR Errors for Children: Quantifying the Impact of Physiological, Cognitive, and Extrinsic Factors

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance across different age groups (grades K-10) and using causal inference metrics like Average Causal Effect (ACE) and Conditional Mutual Information (CMI) to quantify the direct impact of age on substitution, deletion, and insertion errors.

Using causal inference frameworks (ACE and CMI) to measure the sensitivity of Speech Foundation Models to the speaker's gender and evaluating if there are significant performance disparities between boys and girls.

Quantifying the impact of cognitive factors, specifically pronunciation ability measured via Goodness of Pronunciation (GoP) scores, on ASR Word Error Rates using causal directed acyclic graphs (DAGs).
